findings.initialFinding: The initial wording said FOWM and PIA have the same offline buffer and update budget. The primary paper specifies FOWM and PIA-AC; PIA-ODE additionally receives target-geometry ODE trajectories.
findings.requiredFix: Name PIA-AC in the equal-data comparison and explicitly exclude the extra-data PIA-ODE setting.
findings.implementedBy: parent author, during this review; independent reviewer did not edit production content
findings.verifiedCurrentText: FOWM 与 PIA-AC 使用相同离线缓冲区和更新预算，但骨干和目标同时变化，仍不能把全部增益归给某一个模块；PIA-ODE 还加入目标赛道的 ODE 数据，不属于这组同数据对照。
findings.recheckedResult: Correct; the final SHA-256 binding is to the corrected report.

numericalAndProtocolChecks.details: 112 direct CARLA scenes (100 normal plus 12 fault); 60 divergence alarms versus 1 paired admission and 59 false-attribution alarms. The 50-scene refinement has 7 initial and 32 final admissions; 23 search successes plus 8 reflection successes minus 6 overlap gives 25 additional. Search is explicitly the stub backend, with 120 candidates including gated proposals; successful-only first-admission median 8 and maximum 27. The separate gate ablation uses 150 executions and three seeds, 15.3 to 29.0 admissions. Corridor 420 runs and six multi-CV conditions with ten seeds are not added to the unique 112 scenes. EEBL relay collision counts 0/10, 7/10, 9/10 match.

50 ms physics step, GPT-4o temperature 0.2, 10/1/10 Hz SPaT/MAP/BSM, 1.8 m and 2.0 m center-distance thresholds, velocity above 0.5 m/s, and CARLA 2.5 m route screening match the primary text. Information-chain/AoI/admission equations are correct. Shadow-ego noninteractivity and 1-minimal versus global-minimum limits are explicit.

All twelve selected best-lap/miles-per-failure pairs in Table I/II match. SIL PIA-ODE versus PIA-AC difference is 1.99 s. RBR safety regressions and unchanged low-grip PIA-AC stability are retained. Six AC training and three test tracks, 15,000-step episode cap, three seeds, 6M SAC steps per AC track, and Table IV 36M AC plus 3M ODE representative mixture match.

Table III stages use 11/18/39/44 minutes already available before each stage, with 3/8, 5/8, 6/8 and 8/8 success labels, and 5/2/1/1 episodes to first success. Valid sector times and OOT distances match. 52.47-49.55 = 2.92 s, or 5.565% rounded to about 5.6%. The s1 success-label versus valid-time discrepancy is preserved. The report correctly states progressive data accumulation, continued stage interaction, one oval track, early failure, and terminated real-only control.

Table V geometry/dynamics, context and uncertainty ablation rows match; the separate uncertainty configuration is not merged with the 112.17 s configuration. Mixture equation, alpha 1 to 0.5 linear episode schedule, context conditioning, reward/terminal-value Q-disagreement penalty and lack of a calibrated safety guarantee are correctly explained. Input alignment, unavailable observation-channel handling and missing full deployment hyperparameters are bounded.

imageChecks.observations: Four modules, purple grounding, bottom truth/channel/faults/belief chain, paired message/ground-truth ego, causal admission and refinement agree with report lines 68-70. The project-page overview is a different official teaser and was not used as a byte-identity substitute.

Left EEBL lead/CV2/CV3 speed/gap and relay/no-relay/CV2-off conditions, ten-seed collision dots, and right IMA both/one/neither equipment conditions match lines 72-74. Selected collision counts match the plotted dots and section 3.4.

Offline low/high-fidelity images, two buffer cylinders, world model, uncertainty-aware planner, simulation/vehicle deployment and red few-shot feedback arrow match report lines 68-70 and PDF Figure 1 caption.

Five panels IND/RBR/SIL/varying/low grip, green FOWM, blue PIA-AC, red PIA-ODE, best-lap-time vertical axis, episodes horizontal axis and three-seed mean/one-standard-deviation caption match lines 72-74. Running-best speed is not represented as a per-episode safety metric.

primarySourceInconsistenciesPreserved.verified: Section 3.1 says 110/112 first-attempt compiles while section 3.2 gives mean 1.58 attempts for 100 normal scenes; denominators/attempt definitions are not reconciled in the source. Figure 7 revision text says frozen red, but the timeline and screenshots show received green. Report does not invent a reconciliation. Fixed-arXiv diagnostic image was opened and independently byte-matched.

Official Figure 5 success proportions do not exactly match Table III eight-episode counts, notably s1 near 43% versus 37.5%. Appendix geometry-only prose calls its lap time slower, while Table V has 113.39 s versus no-ODE 114.16 s. Report retains the tables and flags discrepancies. Figure 5 was actually opened.
